$comment: Reviewed false positives from scripts/lib/skill-scan.js. Each entry is pinned to the file's sha256, so any change to the file requires a fresh review. Keep entries narrow: one skill, one file, one rule.

entries.reason: Quotes "ignore previous rules" as an example of plan text that must NOT be followed.
"Do not tell the user they need to adopt an eval framework" is advice against mandating formats, not concealment.

Comment explains the guard that refuses to append through a planted symlink to ~/.bashrc.
